decision: Replace retained3998 local Sit export with the reviewed COM-X continuation, preserving the previous asset and all experiment evidence. No robot deployment or hardware/TA approval.

base_com.ranges.effective_at: startup; sampled once per world, retained across resets
base_com.ranges.reason: Separate robustness experiment; the +2 cm course test is outside the original +/-1 cm training distribution

controlled_comparison: Same retained3998 warm start,1000 iterations,4096 environments,seed42,original reference/rewards,controller plus class driver clamps,composed COM andfullgroundhulls as prior driver4997. Only torso body-frame X COM training distribution changes from +/-1 cm to +/-2 cm; Y/Z remain +/-1 cm. Exact saved environment configs match apart from X range and copied motion path.
training_distribution_scope: The original +2 cm course robustness case was outside the original +/-1 cm distribution. It is now the boundary of the explicit widened X distribution. Additional fixed-offset evaluations reuse the original training reference: +/-1.5 cm probes lie inside widened X support, while +/-2.5 cm remains outside. These are dynamics probes, not held-out motion trajectories.

boundary_finding.interpretation: GPU runtime passes but local CPU wobbles. Do not claim robust +2.5 cm capability. Runtime/backend-sensitive contact dynamics remain a measured limitation; numerical backend is not isolated from package/runtime differences here.

nominal.visual_review: Rendered12-frame contact sheet inspected against reference; full per-frame trajectory/phase metrics separately checked. Both paw offers and return to stand are present.

com-front.visual_review: Rendered12-frame contact sheet inspected against reference; full per-frame trajectory/phase metrics separately checked. Both paw offers and return to stand are present.

export_audit_interpretation: Strict actor loading,metadata equality,actuator/timebase checks and numerical export parity pass. audit.passed remains false solely because training enables observation corruption while deterministic play disables it; the finding is retained, not suppressed.
limitations: No physical robot test,installed motor-driver verification,thermal endurance or real-world handoff validation.
Course HOLDS UP uses root tracking thresholds; it is not a physical fall detector.
A finite set of dynamics tests does not prove arbitrary payload,surface,push or indefinite-hold robustness.
Local source changed only after the CPU review and its before/after source snapshots completed; future target-slew work is a separate untrained contract and is not part of this policy.
